questions.q: What is the capital of Timor-Leste?
questions.why: It is on the north coast.

questions.q: Which European country ruled East Timor for centuries?
questions.why: Portugal left in 1975.

questions.q: Which neighbour occupied East Timor from 1975 to 1999?
questions.why: Many people died during the occupation.

questions.q: In which year did Timor-Leste become fully independent?
questions.why: It was the first new country of the century.

questions.q: What currency does Timor-Leste use?
questions.why: It also has local centavo coins.

questions.q: Which two languages are official in Timor-Leste?
questions.why: English and Indonesian are working languages.

questions.q: Which independence leader became the first President?
questions.why: He led the guerrilla resistance.

questions.q: Which two Timorese won the 1996 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.a: José Ramos-Horta and Bishop Carlos Belo
questions.why: They worked for a peaceful solution.

questions.q: Which 1991 massacre in Dili brought world attention?
questions.why: It was filmed by a journalist.

questions.q: In which year did East Timor vote for independence in a UN referendum?
questions.why: About 78% voted for independence.

questions.q: Which Australian-led force restored order in 1999?
questions.why: Violence broke out after the vote.

questions.q: Which resistance movement fought Indonesian rule?
questions.why: FALINTIL was the armed wing.

questions.q: Which five journalists were killed in 1975 at a border town?
questions.why: A 2009 film tells their story.

questions.q: In which year did Timor-Leste become ASEAN's 11th member?
questions.why: It had applied in 2011.

questions.q: Which sea between Timor-Leste and Australia holds oil and gas?
questions.why: A 2018 treaty set the sea border.

questions.q: Which half of an island does Timor-Leste mainly cover?
wrong: The northern half of New Guinea
questions.why: West Timor is part of Indonesia.

questions.q: Which statue of Christ overlooks Dili?
questions.why: It is 27 m tall.

questions.q: Which crop is Timor-Leste's main export after oil?
questions.why: It is grown in the hills.

questions.q: Which island off Dili is famous for diving?
questions.why: Its reefs are among the most diverse in the world.

questions.q: Which island neighbour lies south across the sea?
questions.why: Darwin is about 700 km away.

questions.q: What is the main religion in Timor-Leste?
questions.why: It is one of Asia's most Catholic countries.

questions.q: What is the woven cloth of Timor-Leste called?
questions.why: It is given at ceremonies.

questions.q: Which small isolated enclave of Timor-Leste lies in West Timor?
questions.why: It is where the Portuguese first landed.

questions.q: What is Timor-Leste's highest mountain?
questions.why: Pilgrims climb it at dawn.

questions.q: Which crocodile legend explains the island's shape?
questions.a: A boy helped a crocodile who became the island
wrong: A whale swam into the sea
questions.why: The crocodile is a symbol of the nation.

questions.q: What are traditional sacred houses called?
questions.why: They hold ancestral objects.

questions.q: Which national park is the country's first?
questions.why: It includes Jaco Island.

questions.q: Whose name does Dili's international airport carry?
questions.why: Lobato was a resistance leader killed in 1978.

questions.q: Which language family does Tetum belong to?
questions.why: It has many Portuguese loanwords.

questions.q: Which old Portuguese town is the second-largest city?
questions.why: Its old market is a landmark.
